summary: Built a diagnostic companion web UI with real-time telemetry, three-column layout, and WebSocket streaming. Backend endpoints provide live camera feed, runtime state, and pipeline events. Frontend built with Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS. Hotfix branch makes UI fully ready for local download/testing.

step5_verify_on_screen: Three-column layout visible: Left (What Bay-Max Sees), Center (What Bay-Max is Doing), Right (What Bay-Max Remembers)
Camera feed shows live video with face detection overlay when face present
Identity panel shows user name and confidence when recognized (or Unknown/0%)
Posture and Engagement fields show real values or null/unknown if unavailable
Bay-Max animated face responds to pipeline state (idle blink, listening, speaking)
Activity feed shows color-coded events (green=complete, red=error, etc.)
Memory hits panel shows retrieved memories when response is generated
Text input allows typing and submitting messages
